messages:
jordan: quick FYInoticed inconsistent credential discovery across runtimes. Node reads REDWOOD_API_KEY, Python uses RW_API_KEY, CLI likes REDWOOD_KEY. causes onboarding friction in sampleapp and k8s.
lee: yep, users export REDWOOD_API_KEY and `rw login` still prompts.
samir: do we have canonical precedence somewhere?
jordan: noproposal: canonical REDWOOD_API_KEY, fallback to REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY, accept RW_API_KEY for compat. document precedence and case rules.
maya: also need rotation story. long-lived processes don't pick up env changes. suggest opt-in CredProvider interface with refresh callbacks and example secret-manager adapter.
olivia: SDKs must treat empty-string env as unset. add tests for that. also log fallback events.
devops-bot: note: k8s env names are case-sensitive; recommend UPPER_SNAKE.
security: do not silently elevate scope on fallback. log and audit all fallbacks.
samir: small bug: Node getDefaultKey() returns "" when env set to empty; should return null. filing issue.
jordan: i'll draft a one-paragraph RFC and cred-lint rule to detect env var mismatches.
devex: action list: sampleapp + k8s sidecar example (lee), SDK tests + hot-reload (olivia), CLI note for `rw creds refresh` (samir), security review (security).
